title: Love it
text: Love it. I love these ice trays So much that I bought 4 more. They come with a lid that fits on nicely so you can stack the trays in your freezer easy.They don't take up a lot of room. When you take the trays out of your freezer You just let them sit for about a minute Then you Take the lid off the tray Turn it upside down and push on the bottom rubber part And ice cubes just pop right out so Easy easy easy. I Have to check if they have larger size cube trays Because they are so easy to use

product_metadata.title: Ice cube trays for freezer - Stackable ice cube trays with lids, Small breastmilk ice cube tray reusable 2 Pack,Easy Release, Space Saving Silicone for Chilled Drinks, Whiskey, Cocktails
features: 【Food Grade Material】:Made of high quality silicone and pp. The silicone ice cube tray is ideal for home, bars, and parties. No worry about breaking easily.
【Easy to Release】:This ice cube tray has flexible silicone bottom, which makes it easy to release the ice cubes. Press the silicone part of the bottom, the perfect ice cube will pop up.

【Multi-purpose Ice Cube Trays】:This Ice cube trays for freezer is not only perfect for making ice cubes, but also ideal for filling with juice, coffee, fruit, tea or anything else you’d like. Provide you pleasant ice-making experience.

【Stackable & Spill Proof Design】: The practical lids can keep the ice from odors of freezer and space by stacking together. The snap-tight lid of silicone ice cube tray also can keep the water from spilling.
【Easy to Clean】: These ice cube trays made of food grade silicone,which temperature resistant between -4℉ to 176℉. The smooth silicone surface of ice tray making it easy to clean off quickly.
